privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page describes how information shared through this website is handled.
privacy.placeholderNotice: Placeholder policy. Replace this content with a privacy policy reviewed for your business and jurisdiction before launch.

sections.heading: Information you share
paragraphs: When you submit a staffing request, you may share your name, company name, business email, phone number and details of your requirement. This information is used only to respond to your request.
In the current demo build of this website, form submissions are validated in your browser and are not transmitted or stored.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: This website stores your theme preference (light or dark) in your browser's local storage. No tracking cookies are set by default.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about this policy can be sent to the contact email listed in the website footer.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of this website.
terms.placeholderNotice: Placeholder terms. Replace this content with terms reviewed by a qualified professional before launch.

sections.heading: Indicative information
paragraphs: Salary ranges, budgets and other figures displayed on this website are indicative and do not constitute a quotation, offer or guarantee. Actual terms are confirmed in writing for each requirement.

sections.heading: Scope of service
paragraphs: The company provides permanent staffing and recruitment assistance to businesses. Employment relationships are between the hiring business and the employee.

sections.heading: Website content
paragraphs: Content on this website may be updated without notice. Sample content is clearly labelled as such until actual business information is published.
